question: How should sacred ash marks be applied to the body in this ritual context?
premises: Application is done according to the limbs.
The marks may be tilaka or tripuṇḍraka.
inference: After applying sacred ash according to the limbs, one may use tilaka marks or tripuṇḍraka marks.
uncertainties: The form bhamasnālabhya is irregular in transmission and may reflect a variant of bhasmanā snātvā or bhasma-snāna.
plain_english: Having applied sacred ash according to the limbs, one may use tilaka marks or triple marks.
